contexts.text: The Most Ancients compared the goods and truths with man to metals...
The Lord's Church... is compared to metals...
All metals = good or truth; in the opposite sense, evil or falsity...
In metals and stones there are conglobations of parts in a three-fold order.
Stony and metallic parts are homogeneous.
There is a like order of these (discrete) degrees... in every metal and stone. The parts of these are such, from which is the whole. Explained.
For the metals in their order = such things as are of good and truth...
The metals... correspond... Hence it is that these metals are also in the Spiritual World...
There is a natural sphere from metals...

If there were not an analogue to free will in every metal... there would not be any metal... for this freely absorbs the ether, breathes out its native things, and rejects the obsolete ones, and redintegrates itself with new ones. Hence there is a magnetic sphere around the magnet, an iron one around iron, etc.
The useful sciences are... metallics, etc.
The metals... from correspondence = spiritual and celestial things...
